descricao: The strangest property of this Level is that time seems to be non-linear. Although it is uncommon, wanderers report seeing past or future versions of themselves for a short while before simply disappearing. Interacting with your past or future selves isn't too difficult but can be risky. If you do, it is possible to give your past or future selves items and things to survive. The way paradoxes solve themselves is by creating an infinite time loop that past versions of you are stuck in. Wanderers may see themselves anywhere from 5 minutes to a few years in the past or future.
